accent-hot.displayName: Hot Red (focus, live, the ticket state word, a text action on hover)

on-accent-ink.displayName: White Ink on Flat Red, large text only

rule.displayName: Row Rule (13% white): under every list row, the footer's top edge

ink-muted.displayName: Muted Ink (resting notes, head-rule notes, roles)

ink-faint.displayName: Faint Ink (4.5:1 floor; row indices, speaker sheet numbers)

display.purpose: The subpage <h1>; the home statement set into the hero plate uses its own clamp(2.8rem, 9.4vw, 8.5rem). One per page.

headline.purpose: The .head-split headline (/agenda, /contact), the FAQ categories, every Closer title: --fs-h2 clamp(2.25rem, min(6vw, 9svh), 5.5rem). Always under the page's display, always over a list row.

head.purpose: The section head on the ruled document (.head-rule-title): Bebas --fs-head clamp(2.1rem, 3.4vw, 3rem), left on a 1px white rule, at most one typewriter note on the right. Every home section, the ticket ledger, the speakers teaser, every /partners tier.

title.purpose: Row title in a ruled list: sessions, FAQ questions, clippings, the ticket waves and their prices.

lede.purpose: Section ledes and status prose; the home facts note and newsletter lede.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono records figures only: row indices and serials (ticket ledger, speaker tiles' sheet numbers), the footer folio, a clipping's date. 0.1 / 0.15em tracking, never uppercased by CSS, never a word-label.

label-lg.purpose: The larger index figure (NextStep), agenda times, the invite meta line. 0.1 / 0.15em.

label-xs.purpose: Micro mono figure (avatar counts, kit file sizes). 0.6875rem = 11px, the mono floor: no figure sets smaller.

note-sm.purpose: Special Elite tells: roles, captions, row metadata (the ticket state word, deadline and alt price, the speaker role, agenda room and track, session chips, .record-status). Sentence case, tracking 0, line-height 1.45; 0.85rem is the floor, Special Elite breaks up under 13px.

note.purpose: Special Elite tells: the .head-rule note, .eyebrow, the hero facts line, the facts <dl>, form labels and errors, the sheet kicker, nav meta, footer links. A label made of words is always this voice, never mono.

action.purpose: Bebas speaks: the text action (.action / .btn-ghost), the nav toggle, the header Tickets, Sheet close, speaker social links, Desk email, Clear. Caps, tracking 0, line-height 1, no glyph.

cta.purpose: The label on a red button (cta-label = action(--fs-cta)): white Bebas at 1.5rem = 24px, the regular-weight large-text line where white on #F11000 (4.36:1) clears AA. Bebas has no bold, so the size carries it; never shrink it.

title-sm.purpose: Bebas 1.45rem: speaker tile names, agenda run-sheet titles, mobile record titles, press-kit variant names.

shadows.name: print-mount
shadows.purpose: A photograph is mounted, not floated: keyline plus shadow.

shadows.name: statement-lift
shadows.purpose: The home statement's legibility lift on the hero photograph; the one text-shadow on the site, for type on a plate only, never on the black ground. Recorded as an open point, not a style.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: The standard control transition: buttons, inputs, links; a text action's colour turning accent-hot on hover and focus. Nothing slides.

motion.name: field
motion.purpose: The row reach field colour and opacity fade.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: The house arrive curve: sheet entry, row pull.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: The signature motion: a B&W photograph develops to colour on hover (the venue route photos, the speaker print on every tile while its link or button is hovered or focused, every photograph in the home 'Past editions' mosaic). With the portrait view transition from a tile into the speaker sheet, the only decorative motion. The hero plate is still; no page entry, no scroll reveal, nothing moves on its own; the home gallery is a still mosaic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's one red fill: the hero's "Get tickets", the live wave's "Buy", a closer's primary, the newsletter submit. White Bebas at --fs-cta 24px (brand manual p. 11; AA as large text only, never shrink), tracking 0, no glyph. Hover inverts the fill; no lift, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: #F11000; border: 1px solid #F11000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2.8rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: The second control, and the last (.action; .btn-ghost draws the same thing for its older callers). Bebas --fs-action caps, tracking 0, no box, no fill, no underline, no glyph; vertical padding only so the inline edge stays on the column, min-height 2.75rem for the target. Hover and focus turn the label red (--color-accent-hot); nothing moves. Every "see all", way-across, EndLine link, the header Tickets and the ticket row's "Company pays" are this.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 0; min-height: 2.75rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-action:hover, .ds-action:focus-visible { color: #F11000; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ruled Head
components.description: The section head of the ruled document (.head-rule): the Bebas --fs-head title left and at most one typewriter note (Special Elite --fs-note, sentence case, muted ink) right, on their baseline, on a 1px white rule that is the first line of the list under it. The note carries a fact the visitor needs ("N confirmed", "VAT included", "DevFest.cz 2025, in photographs") or is left off; never a label of the section's own contents. Every home section, the ticket ledger, the speakers teaser and every /partners tier open on it.
components.css: .ds-head-rule { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; border-bottom: 1px solid #FFFFFF; padding-bottom: 0.8rem; margin: 0; background: #000000; } .ds-head-rule-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 3.4vw, 3rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-head-rule-note { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: A plain typewriter note where a list has no ruled head: the NextStepList head, the /thank-you calendar stub, the invite alias. Special Elite --fs-note, sentence case, no tracking, no decoration, no trailing hairline; never uppercased, never mono.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); margin: 0; }

components.name: Ruled Row (link)
components.description: The container language for every list: a ruled document. Each row closes on a 1px 13%-white rule and opens on --field-step of air; hierarchy is type scale and ink. The meta line is a typewriter note with a mono time figure in it. A row that IS the control paints a full-bleed red reach field on hover and every ink goes full black.
components.html:
• 10:00 · Main hallAgents that ship: a field report01
  • 11:00 · Main hallGenerative UI without the hype02
components.css: .ds-field { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #000000; } .ds-field-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 1.6rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255,0.13); } .ds-row-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0.6rem 2rem; align-items: end; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -2rem; background: #F11000; opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-link:hover, .ds-row-link:hover * { color: #000000; } .ds-row-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-meta { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); } .ds-row-time { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.7); } .ds-row-title { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.7rem, min(4vw, 6svh), 3.4rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row-figure { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.1rem, min(4.2vw, 6svh), 4rem); line-height: 0.9; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); }

components.name: Ticket Ledger Row
components.description: One ruled row per wave under the "Tickets" head (whose note is the VAT line or "<Wave> is the final wave"): [index · state] [wave · deadline] [price · company figure] [Buy + Company pays | state word]. The index is a faint mono figure; the state word, deadline and alt price are typewriter notes; the live wave's state word ("On sale" / "Last chance") and its red Buy are the list's one red mark; a settled wave shows its state word flush right instead. No description, no stamp, no lit ground, no glyph.

components.name: Lit Field
components.description: The text field: a 5.5% white plate with the control-edge boundary, turning accent-hot on focus. The label is a typewriter note (a word, so never mono). Keyboard focus adds the ring tight against the edge.

components.css: .ds-lit-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.62); } .ds-lit-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255,0.4); border-radius: 2px; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-lit-field::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.5); } .ds-lit-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #F11000; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.086); } .ds-lit-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Speaker Tile (casting sheet)
components.description: Speakers as portraits on a regular grid, the same tile on the home page (eight shuffled tiles as links, six at <=1100px, four at <=720px, under the ruled head "Speakers · N confirmed", closed by "All N speakers") and on /speakers (every speaker, each a button opening the sheet; the tile's print morphs into the sheet photo). Four columns, three at <=1100px, two at <=720px. A tile is the shared 4:5 print (B&W, developing while its link or button is hovered or focused), a mono sheet number in faint ink, the Bebas name at --fs-title-sm (red on hover and focus) and the role as a typewriter note clamped to two lines. No card, no ground, no rule: the print carries its own mount.

components.name: Agenda Block
components.description: /agenda as a printed timetable: every talk is a filled block in its room's column, the panel laid opaque over black, 2px corners, a 6px gap of black page between blocks and columns, no column rules. Hover lifts the ground to --panel-hover and draws a red line along the bottom edge; focus keeps an inset red ring. A break or lunch is a quiet line (time and title on a hairline, no ground); empty time stays black. A long speakerless room session (the lounge) is one block spanning its time with the note "Open all day, drop in any time".

components.name: In-prose Link
components.description: A link inside running text (the hairline-link mixin): white, a plain 1px underline in red at 55% three pixels under the baseline, red on hover and focus, no off-site glyph. Colour alone never marks it (SC 1.4.1). The ticket footnotes, the forms' consent lines, the FAQ and privacy prose, the hero facts line's venue link. A standalone link is never underlined: it is a Text Action.
components.html: Need to pay by bank transfer? Request a company invoice.

components.name: End Line
components.description: The last line of a page that asks for no decision, in place of a Closer (404, team, attending, invoice, thank-you pages, press downloads, FAQ): one Special Elite lede line in soft ink and one Text Action, on one baseline.

narrative.northStar: Noir, but loud — one ruled document in three voices
narrative.overview: A film-noir darkroom with one light, set as a ruled document: a single black ground, white ink, greys only as white at an opacity, and red spent once per page as a fill (the one primary button), once per list as a state word, never as running text and never as a ground. Every section opens on a ruled head (a Bebas name left, at most one typewriter fact right, on a 1px white line) and every list row closes on a faint rule; the footer opens on the document's last rule. Two controls and no third: the red fill and the Bebas text action, neither carrying a glyph. Three voices: Bebas speaks (headlines and actions), Special Elite tells (prose and every label made of words), JetBrains Mono records (figures only). Nothing glows, nothing moves on its own; the home plate is a still photograph with the statement set into it, and the photographs under it develop to colour only under the pointer.
keyCharacteristics: One theme, and it is dark
One red fill per page, one red mark per list; red is never running text and never a ground
Two controls site-wide: the red fill and the Bebas text action; no arrow glyphs, a hover is red
Three voices: Bebas speaks, Special Elite tells, JetBrains Mono records figures only; mono never sets a word-label
A ruled document: section heads on a white rule, list rows on a faint rule, the footer on the last rule; no other lines
A head note carries a fact or is left off; never a label of the section's own contents
Lists and sheets, not cards: a wave is a ruled row, a speaker is a print on the casting sheet, a talk is a block on the timetable
Three faces: Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono (brand manual v1.0)
Sharp corners (2px), no pills; no box around a text action
No glow: hover and live states are flat colour changes
No icon library; the only text glyph left is the Sheet's Close ✕

rules.name: The Red Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Brand manual v1.0 (p. 08-09): three colours, #000000, #FFFFFF, #F11000; greys only as white or black at an opacity (panels, ink, washes are white rgba()). Red marks details (a dot, 1-2 headline words, the year, CTA words, the ticket list's state word, a text action under the pointer) and, as a large area, only primary CTA fills and the row reach field. No red ground: every closer, the /partners CTA and the newsletter sit on black. Red is a verb: one word, one button, one state per page. Never running text (in-prose links are white on a red underline), never a wash, never another accent hue. One red mark per list (manual p. 11). Errors stay red: a state.

rules.name: The Size Not Dimming Rule
rules.body: On red, hierarchy comes from size. On flat #F11000 (chips, the reach field) ink is #000000 at full opacity (4.8:1); 85% black is for control boundaries only; white only for large type (4.36:1). A red button's label is white Bebas at --fs-cta 1.5rem = 24px (cta-label = action(--fs-cta)), the regular-weight large-text line; Bebas has no bold, so the size carries it, never smaller. Red type on black (the ticket state word) is 4.82:1.

rules.name: The Two Controls Rule
rules.body: Every action is the page's one red fill (.btn-primary: white Bebas caps at --fs-cta on #F11000, inverted on hover) or the Bebas text action (.action / .btn-ghost: --fs-action caps, tracking 0, no box, no fill, no underline, vertical padding only, min-height 2.75rem, the label turning --color-accent-hot on hover and focus). No arrow glyph anywhere: the → after a link and the ↗ off-site marker are deleted, because a glyph renders differently on every system and the label names the destination. A boxed secondary, an underlined standalone link or a second filled colour is a third control and does not ship. The header's Tickets is a text action; the hero's "Get tickets" is the home page's red.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Bebas speaks: headlines and actions (display(), row-title(), action(), cta-label). Special Elite tells: prose and every label made of words (prose(), note()): the head-rule note, eyebrows, roles, captions, form labels, errors, status words, the ticket state and deadline, agenda room and track labels, session chips, the sheet kicker, nav meta, the footer. JetBrains Mono records: figures only (mono()): prices in data lines, times, row indices and serials, counts, codes, the footer folio. Mono never sets a word-label; a tracked mono caption was the site's "AI" tell. note() is sentence case, tracking 0, line-height 1.45, floored at --fs-note-sm; action() is Bebas caps at --fs-action, tracking 0, line-height 1.

rules.name: The Ruled Head Rule
rules.body: Every section on the ruled document opens on .head-rule: the section's plain name in Bebas --fs-head (clamp(2.1rem, 3.4vw, 3rem)) left, at most one typewriter note (note(), --fs-note, muted ink) right, on their baseline, on a 1px white rule that is the first line of the list under it. No numbered eyebrow, no stamp, no poster h2 on the home page. .head-split stays on the two pages whose head is a sentence (/agenda, /contact).

rules.name: The Head Note Is A Fact Rule
rules.body: A head note carries a fact the visitor needs, never a label of the section's own contents. Tickets ("VAT included" / "Prices in CZK" / "<Wave> is the final wave") and Speakers ("N confirmed") carry one; The event, Past editions, Partners, Newsletter and each /partners tier open on the title alone, because "Eleventh edition" restated the note under it, the tier list restated the wall and "A few emails a year" restated the lede. A note that only names what follows is filler and is left off.

rules.name: The Structural Rule Rule
rules.body: A line is drawn only where it is the edge of a list: the white rule under a section head, the 13%-white rule under every .field-row, the footer's top edge, the agenda's hour ticks, room-head line and break hairlines, data tables, control boundaries, in-prose underlines, a progress spine, the cookie banner's edge. Never a divider floating between sections, a line above the hero's facts line, a ruled readout, a left-edge line, a rule down an agenda room column, or a tile or border behind a partner logo or around a speaker print.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: One --fs-display element per page (the home statement is set into the plate at its own clamp). Ruled heads run at --fs-head; .head-split and Closer titles at --fs-h2; rows at --fs-row-sm.

rules.name: The One Red Word Rule
rules.body: The red accent word and the closing full stop belong to the home hero statement (and the invite title). Every subpage hero title carries neither; section heads and every Closer title are plain white.

rules.name: The No Fake Styles Rule
rules.body: font-synthesis: none. One weight per face (JetBrains Mono loads 400 and 500; 500 only for the press headline) and no italic, so prose emphasis is ink (strong steps up to --color-text). Czech letters Special Elite lacks fall to JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Motion Answers A Change Rule
rules.body: No scroll reveal, no per-section entrance, no page-entry animation: the hero lands still. Nothing moves on its own: no ticker, no countdown, no rotor, no marquee; the home gallery is a still mosaic; the agenda's live dot is static. One signature motion: a high-contrast B&W photograph (manual p. 13) develops to colour on hover (the venue photos, the speaker print on a reached tile, the home mosaic). There is no other hover motion: a text action's hover is a colour change, nothing slides. Hover painting on rows only under (hover: hover).

rules.name: The Bebas Setting Rule
rules.body: Bebas sets uppercase at line-height 0.9-1.0 and tracking 0 (manual p. 10): --lh-display 0.9, --track-display 0, row-title() and action() line-height 1. No Bebas rule carries its own letter-spacing (the cookie buttons' leftover 0.12em is an open point); no text-shadow on the black ground (the home statement's lift on the photograph is an open point, not a style).

rules.name: The Mono Grid Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono tracks at 0.1 or 0.15em (manual p. 10: 0.1-0.2em); the 0.2em step has no caller since word-labels moved to the note voice. A figure is never uppercased by CSS. mono() floors effective tracking at 0.1em under --track-scale; notes and actions carry no tracking and do not move on a phone. Speaker names in Agenda and Sessions are Special Elite lore, sentence case.

rules.name: The Logo Never Shrinks Rule
rules.body: Official files only (manual p. 03-07). The header logo is a fixed 190px box (180px digital minimum) with a max-content brand column; the bar tightens on phones and drops its Tickets action under 600px instead. No opacity change on logo hover, header or footer; nothing darkens the logo. No logo on the home hero plate: the bar carries the mark.

rules.name: The Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every font declaration goes through _type.scss (note, action, cta-label, mono, display, row-title, prose, hairline-link); every font-size through the ramp.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No glow anywhere. Hover and live states are flat colour changes: an inverted fill for the red button, a red label for the text action, a border or ink change for rows and fields. The print mount stays: a photograph is mounted, not floated.

rules.name: The Size By Tier Rule
rules.body: Partner logos sit on the page ground with no tile, border or plate, each in its original colours (brand manual p. 15); dark-ink masters on a paper-white card. Each tier is one left-set wrapping flex row. The tier's reference box sets the size (CELLS: Platinum 600x300, Diamond 330x190, Gold 260x150, Silver 210x120, Community and Media 180x100 px); opticalBox() gives every mark in a tier the same ink area, handed to CSS as --logo-w. /partners opens each tier on a ruled head with no note; the home wall is the same ladder at 0.7 under one ruled head with no note, no tier labels. Phones scale by --logo-scale (0.75 home, 0.7 /partners). Media stays on /partners.

rules.name: The End Line Rule
rules.body: A Closer, on the black ground, ends a page that asks for a decision (speakers, agenda, workshops, venue, invite). A page that asks for none ends on an EndLine (one lede line and one text action) or on its content (legal pages, 404's step list).

rules.name: The One Plate Per Route Rule
rules.body: The detective key art is the home hero's alone, full-bleed, with the statement set into its lower left and nothing else on it. A subpage about the event takes one documentary plate of its own (speakers: devfest-2025-03, partners: devfest-2025-01, agenda: the mill chimney, venue: the mill entrance tower), graded B&W; every other subpage, /team included, opens type-only (photo={false}). Beyond the plates: the venue route photos, the speaker prints on the casting sheet, and on / the speaker teaser's prints and the "Past editions" mosaic of eight press photographs.

rules.name: The Earned Noir Rule
rules.body: Noir wordplay is spent in a few earned places: the home hero statement, the 404 "Nothing filed under that", and at most one closer line per page. Every section and page title says plainly what it is ("The event", "Tickets", "Speakers", "Past editions", "Partners", "Newsletter", "Agenda", "The team", "Questions", "Become a partner"); a ruled head's note is a fact or absent; the hero carries no case-file stamp, the footer's folio is the one case mark left. No triads, no em-dash chains, no hype words.

rules.name: The One Date Format Rule
rules.body: Event facts come from src/lib/event.ts: doors 08:00, keynote 09:00, close 19:00, afterparty to 23:00. "30 October 2026" in running copy, "30 Oct 2026" in mono facts, never "October 30"; 24-hour HH:MM; British "programme".

dos: Do use global primitives by class name (.band, .head-rule, .eyebrow, .display, .field-row, .btn-primary, .action).
Do open every section on .head-rule with the section's name, and a note only where it carries a fact.
Do set every label made of words with note() and every action with action(); keep mono() for figures.
Do rule every list row with --rule and nothing else; let the head's white rule be the list's first line.
Do give every data-backed page a .fallback-note.
Do use --field-border (≥3:1) for any interactive control boundary.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion opt-out to every animation.
Do use .action for every "see all", way-across or secondary link, and the hairline-link mixin for a link inside running text.
Do head a list of next steps with NextStepList's typewriter label, an <ol> when the steps are a sequence.
Do render every partner mark through partnerLogo() and the partner-logo() recipe, so its tier's reference box sets its size.
donts: Don't add a fourth font, an icon package, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS.
Don't set paragraphs in #F11000, add a second red or any other accent hue, or use --color-error as an accent.
Don't add a third control: no boxed or outlined secondary, no underlined standalone link, no second filled colour.
Don't put an arrow or off-site glyph on a link or a button; the label names the destination.
Don't set a word-label in JetBrains Mono, uppercase a note, or track a note or an action.
Don't put a box, a panel or an opacity 'inactive' state on a ruled list row; a row is type on a rule (the agenda's timetable blocks are the one filled entry).
Don't draw a line that is not the edge of a list, a control, a table or a prose link.
Don't paint the reach field on :focus; focus draws a ring.
Don't introduce a prefers-color-scheme block for a single component.
Don't use translateX on the red reach field; the pull belongs to the wash.
Don't put a numbered eyebrow, a stamp or a poster h2 over a home section; the ruled head is the section head.
Don't give a ruled head a note that only names what follows; a note is a fact or nothing.
Don't put a mood eyebrow ('Be there', 'Join us') on a closer; an eyebrow carries a fact or nothing.
Don't paint a red ground under a closer, a form or a section; the red on a screen is its one button.
Don't put a second red fill on a page or a second red mark in a list.
Don't add a glow, a lift or a drop shadow to a hover or live state.
Don't draw a tile, border or plate behind a partner logo; the tier's box carries the rank.
Don't set a mono figure under 11px (--fs-label-xs is the floor) or a note under --fs-note-sm.
Don't typeset the DevFest.cz name as a second wordmark; use the official logo file.
Don't shrink, dim or overlay the logo; change the layout instead.
Don't set a label on red smaller than --fs-cta.
Don't set an inline prose link, a step number, a row index or a separator in red.
Don't put anything on the home plate but the statement; no stamp, no logo, no rotor, no actions.
Don't add anything that moves on its own: no rotor, ticker, countdown or marquee; the gallery is a still mosaic.
Don't spend noir wordplay on a plain title; name the page.
